integrity: An explicit proof and finite, independently formulated DP and enumeration tests are provided; finite checks are not infinite proofs; an unindexed equivalent could exist.
scientific_limitations: For a period with pairwise distinct letters, positive run lengths and an integer number of repetitions; the optimizer-count classification requires a unique largest run; no tied-largest count is asserted.
title: The two-largest-run law for palindromic subsequences of distinct-run powers
